## 3. For whoever owns `tools/v2/hot_lint.py`: cover `blaze-diagnostics`, and fix `crates`

Where: `tools/v2/hot_lint.py`.

What: `{"root": ".", "crates": ["blaze-diagnostics"]}` fails with
`TypeError: typed_input: crates has a type it does not read: list[str]`, since `typed_input`
reads `tuple[str, ...]` and not `list[str]`. Make `Input.crates` a `tuple[str, ...]`, and add
`blaze-diagnostics` to `HOT` if the coordinator counts it as a hot crate.

Why: as it stands, the lint can't be run on this lane's paths.

> forwarded to the coordinator (`tools/`), listed in requests' report.

history.note: tools/v2/hot_lint.py: Input.crates is tuple[str, ...] (any name under crates/ or a path from the root; a missing crate or a run reading no file exits 2); a test cfg is any predicate only test/fuzz builds set (test, all(test, ..), any(test, feature = "fuzz"), fuzzing); files of out-of-line #[cfg(test)] mod x; (and their submodule dirs) and #[path] sources from tests/ are skipped, as is a file under #![cfg(test)]; comments and string/raw-string/char literals are blanked over the whole file (multi-line too) before both the brace count and the checks; \bvec!\[ so smallvec! is not a fresh Vec; HOT gains vendor/salsa, vendor/salsa-macros, vendor/salsa-macro-rules and fuzz (fuzz/targets stays unread, as tests are), blaze-diagnostics was already in; blaze-tier (no such crate) dropped. blaze-diagnostics is in HOT; its one finding now is lower/unresolved_import.rs:558 (a to_owned in a note), for its owner.
